senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (गजति)
To be drunk, to be confused or inebriated:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (गजति गजयति) also (इ) गजि r. 1st cl. (गञ्जति)
To sound.

m. (-जः)
1 An elephant.
2 A measure of length, the Gaz, a yard, a measure of two cubits.
3 A mound of earth sloping on both sides, on which a house may be erected.
4 A small hole in the ground for a fire, over which to prepare medicines.
E.
गज to sound, to roar, affix अच्

m. (-न्दः)
A large esculent root, a sort of arum.
E.
गज, and कन्द root.

m. (-शी)
A name of GARUḌA the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
E.
गज an elephant, कूर्म्म a tortoise, and अशिन् who eats; alluding to a legend of his swallowing both animals whilst engaged in a contest with each other.

mf. (-टः-टा)
A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis Madraspatanus.)

f. (-या)
A portion of time proper for a Śrāddha.
E.
गज, and छाया shadow.

f. (-क्का)
A kettle drum carried on an elephant.
E.
गज an elephant, and ढक्का a large drum.

f. (-ता)
A multitude of elephants.
E.
गज an elephant, तल् aff.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
As high or tall as an elephant.
E.
गज, and दघ्नच् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A name of GAṆEŚA.
2 Ivory, the elephant's tooth.
3 A bracket or pin projecting from the wall.
E.
गज a elephant, and दन्त a tooth; GAṆEŚA is represented with an elephant's head.

n. (-नं)
The liquor exuding from an elephant's temples.
E.
गज, and दान the same.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
As high as an elephant.
E.
गज, and द्वयसच् aff.

m. (-तिः)
1 A large state elephant.
2 A king.
E.
गज, and पति a master.

f. (-ली)
A plant bearing a seed which resembles pepper, (Pothos officinalis.)
E.
गज an elephant, and पिप्पली long pepper; considered to be a large species of pepper: see similar names, as करिपिप्पली, इभकणा, &c.

m. (-वः)
A large and excellent elephant.
E.
गज, and पुङ्गव implying eminence.

m. (-टः)
A small hollow for a fire, over which to prepare medical decoctions, extracts, &c.
E.
गज, and पुट a hollow.

f. (-या)
The gum olibanum tree, (Boswellia serrata).
E.
गज an elephant, and प्रिय beloved; also वल्लकी.

f. (-नी)
A post to which an elephant is bound.
E.
गज, and बन्धन a binding.

m. (-कः)
The sacred fig tree.
E.
गज, and भक्षक eater; the young branches of the Pipal being the elephant's favourite food.

f. (-क्षा)
The gum olibanum tree: see गजप्रिय.
E.
गज an elephant, and भक्षा food; also गजभक्ष्या.

f. (-का)
A ring or circle of elephants surrounding a car, &c.
E.
गज, मण्डल a circle, कन् affix fem. form.

m. (-लः)
A lion.
E.
गज an elephant, मा fortune, and चल what goes; the destroyer of the elephant.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
As tall as an elephant.
E.
गज, and मात्रच् aff.

f. (-क्ता)
A pearl, supposed to be found in the head of an elephant.
E.
गज, and मुक्ता a pearl.

m. (-नः)
A lion.
E.
गज an elephant, मुट to run away, in the causal form, affix ल्युट्; or with मुच to go, गजमोचन as it is sometimes read.

m. (-थः)
A herd of elephants.
E.
गज, and यूथ a herd.

m. (-नः)
A name of GAṆEŚA, who is represented always with the head of an elephant.
E.
गज, and वदन a face.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Who walks like an elephant.
n. (-जं)
1 A troop of elephants.
2 The pace of an elephant.
E.
गज, and व्रज a number or going, who goes, &c.

n. (-यं)
A famous city, Hastinapur the capital of the KURUS.
E.
गज, स for सम् with, and आह्वय an appellation; named from its elephants; also गजाह्व, &c.

m. (-णीः)
The elephant of INDRA.
E.
गज, and अग्रणी preeminent.

m. (-वः)
An elephant keeper or driver.
E.
गज, and आजीव who lives; who gets his livelihood by elephants.

m. (-नः)
The deity GAṆEŚA.
E.
गज an elephant, and आनन a face; see गजवदन.

m. (-रिः)
1 A lion.
2 A particular tree.
E.
गज, and अरि a foe.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Mounted or riding on an elephant.
E.
गज, and आरूढ mounted.

m. (-नः)
The religious fig tree.
f. (-ना)
1 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.)
2 The gum olibanum tree.
3 The root of a lotus.
E.
गज, and अशन food; the food of elephants.

m. (-स्यः)
GAṆEŚA: see गजानन.
E.
गज an elephant, and आस्य a face.

n. (-ह्वं)
The city Hastinapur.
f. (-ह्वा)
A plant: see गजपिप्पली.
E.
गज, and आह्वा a name: see गजसाह्वय.

n. (-य)
Hastinapur, the ancient Dehli: see the preceding.

m. (-न्द्रः)
1 A large and excellent elephant.
2 INDRA'S elephant.
E.
गज, and इन्द्र chief.

f. (-णा)
A sort of pepper: see गजपिप्पली.
E.
गज, and उषणा pepper.
